candidates.title: waiting_screen_spotlight_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight view with an interactive tip carousel explaining pet commands while generation completes.
candidates.why: Median waiting screen time is 201s with a 2336s mean, causing high user drop-off during long pet generation.

components.text: Discover pet commands while your desktop companion is created.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen while maintaining its job and rules.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower drop-off than others; redesigns have shown negative lift in prior tests; costly new UI components required.

candidates.title: pick_friend_split_selection_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout showcasing companion traits and animations side-by-side.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest completion in the funnel (60.9%) and takes 89s median time.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: sign_in_card_layout_redesign

candidates.why: Sign-in screen drops 27.1% of users, and 8 support tickets noted confusion around missing pets after sign-in.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout while retaining core job.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% and support mails confirm user confusion, but major UI redesigns carry poor historical performance.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Journey

candidates.title: choose_path_headline_copy_update
candidates.change: Update the headline and body text on choose_path to clearly state the simple difference between pre-made and custom pets.
candidates.why: Users take 514s on average at choose_path, indicating confusion about which path to select.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Creation Method
choose_path.body: Choose an instant pre-made pet or generate a custom companion from your photo.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy while preserving both adoption and custom paths.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has high drop-off and high completion time, though no support tickets; copy changes are low cost and low risk.

candidates.title: upload_photos_quality_hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint box on upload_photos detailing clear lighting and face visibility requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation results, use a well-lit photo with a clear, forward-facing view.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint to photo upload screen without policy violations.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the highest funnel drop (39.1%) with matching support tickets; adding quality hints is targeted and low risk.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_progress_indicators
candidates.change: Enable time estimate displays and active progress notifications on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off while waiting.

guard.reason: Adds accurate progress indicators to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home has minor drop-off relative to adoption/finish; funnel shows long wait times; progress indicator config is simple to enable.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_controls_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit interaction hint on home_intro explaining how to summon, right-click, and command the pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about controlling or hiding their pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to access commands, settings, or hide it.

guard.reason: Adds interaction guidance to home intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support reports post-setup confusion; adding guidance hints targets a real bottleneck.
